What we fix

HX Auto Service is a car workshop in Taman Bukit Indah, close to the Second Link, for car service in Iskandar Puteri and Johor Bahru.

  • Computer diagnostics and coding

    Warning light on? We scan the car first.

  • Service and oil change

    Engine oil, filter and a general check.

  • Engine and transmission

    Engine repair and transmission service.

  • Aircond

    Aircond service and flushing.

  • Brakes, suspension, tyres and alignment

    Stop, steer and ride right.

  • Battery and electrical

    Slow starts and electrical faults.

  • Undercarriage check

    A look underneath, on the lift.

  • Towing and recovery

    Car will not move? Call us.

All services

How it works

  1. 1

    WhatsApp

Questions drivers ask

Where is HX Auto Service?

At 47 Jalan Indah 16/11, Taman Bukit Indah, 79100 Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru. The workshop is close to the Second Link.

What are your opening hours?

On Google: Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 7:30pm, Thursday from 9:00am, and Sunday closed.

Do Singapore cars come here?

Yes. Many of the cars in our workshop photos carry Singapore plates. WhatsApp us before you cross so we can plan the bay.

How do I book?

WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 with your car model, year and what you notice. You can also call the same number.
